methods.name: Causal forest with local centering, little-bags variances and the AIPW ATE (grf::causal_forest)
methods.reference: grf 2.x (not installed; not a case dependency): formulas written out in R from grf's sources (InstrumentalRelabelingStrategy, InstrumentalSplittingRule, RegressionSplittingRule, InstrumentalPredictionStrategy, ObjectiveBayesDebiaser, get_scores.causal_forest, average_treatment_effect) and property tests on R-generated designs (oracle AIPW with the true nuisances, naive differences, Welch SEs); thresholds calibrated by an R emulation of the algorithm. The forest outputs (ATE, CATEs, variances) are not R-pinned: the cf_confounded, cf_rct and cf_rare tests hold them to properties of those R values
quantities: AIPW scores, ATE and SE (formula, also on a subset)
stabilised causal split and regression split (feature, threshold, decrease)
pooled CATE, first stage, little-bags variance components, debiased variance (complete and incomplete groups)
ATE on confounded designs with tau = 0, 1, 1 + 2 x1 (coverage, bias, SE vs oracle)
CATE correlation with tau, importance, new-data predictions
ATE SE vs Welch SE and its 1/sqrt(n) scaling
methods.tolerance: formula pins: validation/README.md (Tol::coef for scores, estimates, tau and first stage; Tol::se for SEs; Tol::stat for decreases and variances; features and thresholds exact); property tests: |ATE - truth| <= 0.15 (n = 1000), CI coverage of the truth, SE within [0.8, 1.25] of the oracle AIPW SE and [0.85, 1.3] of the Welch SE, SE(2000)/SE(500) in [0.4, 0.6], rare-treatment mean CATE within 0.1 of 5; all from seeded fits, thresholds at least twice the emulated deviations

deviations.note: ceil(sqrt(p)) (p2a default_mtry) as the mean of the Poisson candidate count, not grf's min(ceil(sqrt(p) + 20), p)
